intro: The Shipping Act 1994 permits bare-boat chartering in and out of the Barbados flag.

directions.label: Charter out
directions.title: Out of the Barbados flag
directions.body: Ships already registered with Barbados flag may opt to bare-boat charter under another flag, whilst maintaining suspended registration status with Barbados. Mortgages may continue to be recorded but the ship would be operating under the laws of the 'secondary' flag.
points: Barbados registration is suspended, not closed
Mortgages may continue to be recorded
The ship operates under the laws of the 'secondary' flag

directions.label: Charter in
directions.title: In to the Barbados flag
directions.body: For a ship wishing to bare-boat charter in to Barbados, consent from the foreign flag would be required, or evidence that such consent was not required.
points: Or evidence that such consent was not required

agreement.lead: In all cases, a copy of the charter-party agreement must be provided to the Registrar, clearly stating:

items.t: The intended duration of the charter period
items.d: Normally between two and five years, with extensions possible thereafter.

items.t: The full name and address of the parties to the agreement

notes.d: Any such charter-party must be in English.
We would recommend the use of BIMCO standard BARECON agreements.
